title: Lists
emptyBody: Collect titles for a mood, a marathon or a friend. You can share any list later.
verifyBanner: Confirm your email to see lists friends share with you.
sharedEmpty: When a friend shares a list with {{email}}, it shows up here.

form.cantEditBody: It doesn’t exist any more, or only its owner can change it.
form.name: Name

note.label: Note for “{{title}}”
note.placeholder: Why is it on this list?

errors.permission: You don’t have permission to change this list.

page.missingBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong. Private lists open only for their owner and members.
page.hintGuest: If it was shared with you, sign in with the invited email.
page.hintUnverified: If it was shared with you, confirm your email first: shared access needs a verified address.
page.emptyAddBody: Search movies and series and pick as many as you like. Each can carry a short note.
page.emptyBody: Titles appear here when the owner or an editor adds them.
page.viewerBanner: You can view this list. Ask {{owner}} for editor access to add titles.
page.linkBannerUser: You’re viewing a shared link. Copy it to your lists to make changes.
page.linkBannerGuest: You’re viewing a shared link. Sign in to copy it to your lists.
page.deleteBody: The list and its {{titles}} will be deleted. Your library isn’t affected.
page.leaveBody: You’ll lose access to this list. To come back, ask {{owner}} to invite you again.
